title: Feature request
symptom: User wants to allow treatment uploads to Nightscout from follower phones without uploading CGM data, to avoid duplicate CGM entries. They ask if there is a way to skip CGM uploads to NS from these devices.
cause: The thread clarifies that followers automatically sync all data to the master, and if the master is the only device uploading to Nightscout, there will be no duplicate data. The user's initial configuration of each follower with its own Nightscout sync was unnecessary and could cause duplicates.
fix: Configure only the master xDrip+ phone to upload to Nightscout. Followers will sync treatments and entries to the master, which then uploads to NS. Do not set up Nightscout sync on follower phones.
evidence_quote: You only need the xDrip+ master feeding to NS. Entries made on the follower phones are synced with the master immediately, regardless of their proximity.
